tests.method: node --import tsx --test tests/learning*.test.ts against vp_mod_learning on the throwaway cluster, 3 consecutive green runs; tsc clean

works: Propose: evidence = open issues, moments (by hazard), recent live calls with judge results, and the workspace's lessons; the LLM (purpose 'learning', JSON) returns ops on the latest version's config; every cited id is checked against this workspace's own rows; uncited proposals are gated out

Gates (block, never warn): editable allowlist, empty locked-section diff on the resolved config, provenance (no new number or unverified domain), manipulation lint (incl. Hinglish urgency), never-say, shared lintAgentConfig and replyDoor
Tenant library: a change this workspace already rejected, lost or stopped (same change hash) is not re-proposed

Probe: test.simulate on current and proposed configs with the same sim callers and seeds; fewer passes or any guarded metric worse (safety_violations, disclosure_missed, hung_up, cut_ins, reply_gap_ms) rejects and records a lesson; unreported metrics are listed, not assumed fine

Accept (A2): treatment version (brief via brief.compile), baseline from the workspace's own live calls on the control version (or given), Fleiss power at alpha 0.05 / power 0.8, calls-to-prove stored on the proposal and the experiment before launch, pre-registration hash
Start (A2): shadow A/A (1,000 re-randomisations of the tenant's own contacts) plus outcome-plumbing check; too little history waits (aa_pending), broken plumbing fails (aa_failed + issue)
Assign: sticky arm per contact (hash of experiment and contact); stopped/decided experiments send no traffic

Check: test calls excluded; any treatment safety violation, 3+ complaints/opt-outs at 2x control, or the always-valid mSPRT harm test stops the arm at once, calls deployment.revert_to_last_good (A3), opens a critical issue and records a lesson

No peeking: effect is neither computed nor shown before the horizon and the minimum days; at the horizon one two-sided two-proportion z test; a win is sent to version.publish only if that tool is approval-gated, so it becomes an A2 card
No pooling: every query filters by workspace; rows in another workspace that point at this workspace's versions are ignored (tested)
untested: Against real sibling modules (all four sibling tools are fakes in tests)
With a real LLM: proposal quality, cost per cycle, and the INR 200/day test budget are not metered here
Moment-level fast lane on live calls (moment rows are read as evidence; this module does not compute hazards)
Clustered standard errors: the unit is the contact, but repeat calls within a contact are collapsed rather than modelled
Winner expiry/drift (60 days) and re-confirm cards; staged safety ramp (first 50 calls at 20%); Bonferroni for more than two arms
Retry/pacing policy changes: they live in campaigns, outside the agent config this module edits
Guardrails other than safety violations and complaint/opt-out reason codes (cut-ins, reply gap, disclosure rate, CLI flags)
needs_from_others: agents: test.simulate {agentId, config, simCallerIds, seeds} -> {runs:[{simCallerId, seed, passed, metrics:{hung_up, safety_violations, disclosure_missed, cut_ins, reply_gap_ms}}]} (risk test)
agents: brief.compile {config: AgentConfig} -> {text, hash, bytes}; without it a treatment version cannot start
agents: version.publish {agentId, versionId} registered as an A2 risk class (learning refuses to call it otherwise)
agents or calls: deployment.revert_to_last_good {agentId} (A3 verb in shared/approval.ts)
calls/campaigns: call experiment.assign {agentId, contactId} at dial time and stamp conversation.agent_version_id with the version that actually ran

calls/intelligence: conversation.outcome values (default success value 'success', configurable per experiment), reason_code 'opt_out'/'complaint'/'abuse_report', analysis.safety_violation and analysis.judge
a scheduler: run experiment.check after each connected call on an agent with a running experiment
kernel: add learning to server/modules/index.ts (module export: module from server/modules/learning/index.ts)
